headline: Sasikala Varadachari steps down from TVS Holdings board
hook: End of tenure for TVS Holdings director
summary: TVS Holdings Limited has announced the cessation of Ms. Sasikala Varadachari as a Non-Executive Independent Director, effective October 23, 2026. Her departure is due to the successful completion of her tenure. The company made this disclosure in a regulatory filing to the stock exchanges. Routine board changes of this nature typically have no direct impact on the stock's operational performance or retail investor holdings.
whats_next: Appointment of a replacement independent director
why_it_matters: Routine board exit with zero impact on stock price

headline: TVS Holdings issues notice for a shareholder postal ballot
hook: Postal ballot notice sent to holders
summary: TVS Holdings Limited has officially notified the stock exchange regarding the dispatch of a notice for a postal ballot. The filing is a procedural corporate action required for seeking shareholder approvals on specific resolutions. Such routines are standard corporate governance practices for listed entities. Indian retail investors holding TVS Holdings shares should review the ballot details when received.
whats_next: Voting results of the postal ballot
why_it_matters: Routine governance filing with no direct impact on stock price
